review.description: Add S5 owner-only managed dependency check/update jobs, active-work exclusion, stable request-ID deduplication, verified Codex activation, GitHub skill backups/local-edit rejection, opt-in legacy migration and uncertain recovery. Existing release rollback/service/route preservation remains; OS prerequisites are explicitly external. Owner runtime instructions now name dkropachev/codex and the verified dependency API instead of the retired exact 0.161.0 pin; this documents the already implemented and tested source/activation policy without changing specification adoption or execution recipes.
review.implementation: Reviewed private DependencyHandler routing/auth/body bounds, Manager.UpdateDependencies lifecycle/store/gate, configured fork candidate digest and Probe before runtime/provider activation, native plugin observation and deduplicated profile rebinding, GitHub pinned archives/atomic exchange, canonical DK migration and startup restoration of referenced archived skills. App-server provider reads use a lock-protected getter; old auth/global programs and frozen runs are preserved. Git marketplaces are refreshed independently with explicit running/checked/failed results; one renamed or failing source preserves only its own plugins. Cached owner inventory filters uninstalled catalogs and excludes skill contents. The owner explicitly selected dkropachev/codex: latest-release lookup, asset-origin validation, recorded result source and package dependency metadata all use that fork; no stock upstream fallback is allowed. Owner runtime instructions now name dkropachev/codex and the verified dependency API instead of the retired exact 0.161.0 pin; this documents the already implemented and tested source/activation policy without changing specification adoption or execution recipes.
review.tests: Actual assertions cover repeated-ID no replay, changed-ID requests, active-run and launch exclusion, partial native failures without secret stderr, crash uncertain marking, skill pinned upgrade/backup/provenance plus local-edit conflict, Codex success and failed protocol retention, native migration/profile restore and duplicate-discovery/frozen-run retention. Archive tests reject traversal/links/duplicates/budget failures and verify digest/companions. REST tests assert owner/origin/strict JSON/status; public gateway tests assert no admin route. Full current mapped suites run separately from live upgrade acceptance. TestDependencyMarketplaceFailureDoesNotBlockIndependentPlugins asserts one failed marketplace and another successfully updated plugin with no secret stderr; TestDependencyInventoryExcludesSkillContents asserts installed-only metadata without content leakage. The release test asserts the exact dkropachev/codex metadata URL and rejects an otherwise checksum-valid openai/codex asset. Owner runtime instructions now name dkropachev/codex and the verified dependency API instead of the retired exact 0.161.0 pin; this documents the already implemented and tested source/activation policy without changing specification adoption or execution recipes.
